instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Salt extraction and refining facility producing 25,000 tons of industrial and food-grade salt annually from marine evaporation pans. Weather-dependent production cycles create forecasting challenges. Evaluating brine concentration sensors and automated crystallization monitoring. A tight-knit operation where everyone wears multiple hats. We have no dedicated innovation budget — improvements happen opportunistically when the team identifies a clear bottleneck affecting our core operations or customer experience.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: Our core business is stable and cash-generative, but we see limited growth potential within our current market. We are actively exploring adjacent business models — potentially a marketplace, a subscription-based service layer, or a data monetization play built on the proprietary data we already collect. We are willing to incubate 2-3 experimental business lines with seed funding to test viability.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

input.changes_since_last: Transitioning from founder-led to professional management. Hired 2 senior leaders. Strategic planning process being formalized.

opportunities.title: Operational Data Services & Predictive Maintenance Overlay
opportunities.rationale: The successful IoT pilot (15% downtime reduction) proves the value of data collection. This opportunity focuses on maturing this internal capability into a formalized, repeatable service layer that can be productized for external revenue streams or optimized internally via standardized processes.

first_actions: Engage specialized system architects to map current IoT data flows against legacy maintenance APIs (Compliance/Integration Step).
Develop a structured Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for data anomaly detection and root cause analysis, moving beyond founder expertise.
Conduct a feasibility study on integrating historical failure rates with real-time sensor data.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in unplanned downtime exceeding 20% across the full fleet within six months.
milestones: Pilot deployment of predictive alerts to maintenance team (Month 3)
Creation of a formal internal 'Predictive Maintenance Service Catalog' (Month 6)

opportunities.title: Adjacent Market Data Monetization Playbook
opportunities.rationale: The strategic goal is diversification, specifically targeting data monetization. This opportunity focuses on creating a repeatable process (a playbook) to package proprietary operational and market data into sellable insights or subscription services, mitigating founder dependency in the initial strategy phase.

first_actions: Identify 3 core datasets that are standardized and anonymized for external sharing (e.g., regional seasonal usage patterns).
Develop a low-fidelity Minimum Viable Product (MVP) data visualization dashboard prototype.
Draft preliminary legal/compliance requirements for third-party data sharing agreements.
execution_plan.success_metric: Identification and validation of a potential paying pilot customer for the data product within 9 months.
milestones: Completion of Data Inventory and Classification (Month 2)
Definition of initial target buyer persona/industry (Month 4)
Development of the first pricing model iteration (Month 6)

next_steps.action: Formalize the operational data architecture by allocating resources to integrate all IoT streams into a centralized data lake, prioritizing compliance sign-off.
Establish a quarterly 'Innovation Hypothesis Workshop' to structure the incubation of diversified business lines, moving decision-making away from founder reliance.
Develop a formal process for risk assessment on new market entries, ensuring technical and financial viability is vetted before dedicated resources are committed.

key_weaknesses: High dependence on the founder for critical product and technology decisions, limiting scalability and speed.
The formal innovation budget remains critically low (1% of revenue), constraining proactive experimentation.
Process gaps persist in cross-functional data governance, which is essential for full IoT rollout and data monetization.

improvements: Successful transition toward professional management structure with the hiring of two senior leaders.
Tangible success in implementing IoT sensors, achieving a proven 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented assets.
Formalized strategic direction towards diversification (Marketplace/Data) has been established.
persistent_gaps: The full integration of the IoT system with legacy maintenance APIs remains complex and incomplete.
Decision-making power is still highly centralized with the founder, inhibiting autonomous innovation bandwidth.
A clear, funded process for evaluating new business models needs to be institutionalized.
achieved_milestones: Business case approved for full fleet IoT rollout.
Proof of concept validated: 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on pilot equipment.
Strategic goal (diversification) formalized and accepted by leadership.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant structural improvements were noted (hiring, formal planning). Operational progress was achieved via IoT deployment. However, key organizational barriers and the functional dependency on the founder persist.
